subject: Durable materials for everyday kitchens
hook: Kitchens made for school runs and Sunday roasts.
gbp:
A kitchen has to cope with more than any other room: steam, spills, school bags, wet dogs and doors opened dozens of times a day. SUPERIO designs and builds bespoke kitchens for families in Uttoxeter and across Staffordshire, specified for everyday use rather than the showroom.

Our cabinets are made from engineered board (MFC and MDF) with every exposed edge sealed in ABS edging to keep moisture out. Soft-close hinges and drawer runners come as standard. At the design stage we help you choose a finish that suits your household — matt, super matt, gloss, painted or wood-effect — based on how it handles fingerprints, scuffs and cleaning.

What's included: a free, no-obligation design consultation; a full measure and an itemised quote with no hidden costs; manufacture in our own workshop in Hanley, quality-checked before it leaves; and delivery and installation by our own team.

Tap Learn more to see our bespoke kitchens.
